This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Color|brown]]-skinned [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their sunken faces, large [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s, spikes running across their craniums, and large [[Ear|ears]] set far back on the sides of their heads.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[3 BBY]], a two members of this species walked together on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]]. They wore similar red-brown robes with circular metallic pendants at their chests.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:UnidentifiedSpeciesGhorman-IvanManzella.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by Ivan Manzella.]]
The species made their debut in the [[Harvest|sixth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref>
